_comment: Positioning against open, same-task baselines on the 7 real-error targets. NOT a leaderboard: it isolates what the engine's DISCIPLINE (defense-gate, admissibility, declared boundary) adds over an undisciplined use of the same model. Anonymized: no vendor named; only finding counts, landing, and mechanism class. The 'vanilla' arm is a strong single-vendor LLM prompted 'find all the flaws, be thorough'; the 'disciplined' arm is the same model under the engine's protocol. statcheck is a deterministic OSS stats-consistency checker (GPL-3.0). reproduce.py recomputes every value.

llm_judge.note: discipline does NOT change WHICH targets are caught (landing identical, 4/7, same targets); it cuts the noise (~5x fewer findings) and adds a declared boundary. The 3 missed targets are exactly the domain-re-derivation class — missed even by the 155-finding firehose: the boundary is a property of the task, not of discipline.

statcheck.note: deterministic OSS baseline: 0/7 on these targets. Its class (APA-style NHST p-value recomputation) is disjoint from these real defects, and it is format-fragile on full-text. Measures class-breadth, not a head-to-head.
